decision.decision: Retain compact mode1 only as the default-off experimental q8192 prefill baseline. Both ON TTFT observations are below both OFF observations, with231.34525ms median saving at the unchanged full GB10 boundary. TPOT medians are100.942518/102.3135815ms OFF/ON and do not improve; no total-request, decode, retained-performance or release improvement is claimed. The option does not activate at decode length1. Do not spend further narrow tuning on this collector while TTFT remains25.379s; investigate a broader cross-operator route that can remove projection corrections before convolution while preserving its full BF16 output and continuation halo.

scope: Four fresh real-model q8192/out512 processes run OFF,ON,ON,OFF on identical new MoE and pinned whole/FLA/CK/CLI artifacts. All arms retain adaptive linear OUT mode2, combined exact attention and register PV. The sole environment difference is the fused down consumer collector. Each run independently checks the original8192 prompt IDs, all512 GB10 output IDs, all512 actual callbacks and first logit within0.125. Matching internal counts are diagnostics, not the correctness authority. The consumer certificate remains conditional on the existing empirical PPB512 projection envelope, with original selected replay for uncertified cells. The complete unrounded residual is the preservation boundary; no external reference enters runtime computation. Two observations per arm do not establish broad prompt correctness, a proven hardware envelope, prefix/long-context acceptance, total peak memory, retained performance or release readiness.
